QF.id: Analysis of Equity and Debt Instruments_9

question.text: A REIT distributes income to its unitholders comprising: (i) Rs.5 per unit as interest income received from SPV, (ii) Rs.3 per unit as dividend received from SPV (the SPV has exercised the concessional tax regime under Section 115BAA), and (iii) Rs.2 per unit as repayment of debt by SPV (the SPV's debt is not taxable in the REIT's hands and the distribution has not been previously taxed as other income in the unitholder's hands). How is each component taxed in the hands of the unitholder?

answer.text: All three components are exempt in the unitholder's hands due to pass-through status
(i) Exempt, (ii) Taxable at slab as other sources, (iii) Taxable at slab as other sources
(i) Taxable at slab as other sources, (ii) Taxable at slab as other sources, (iii) Taxable u/s 56(2)(xii) as other sources
(i) Taxable at slab, (ii) Exempt, (iii) Exempt as return of capital

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pp. 277-283), REIT distributions have three components with distinct treatments. (i) Interest income from SPV passes through to the unitholder - taxable at slab. (ii) Dividend from SPV is taxable in the unitholder's hands ONLY when the SPV has exercised the concessional regime under Section 115BAA (the stem now states it has) - taxable at slab as other sources. (iii) "Repayment of debt by SPV" distributed to unitholders is taxable under Section 56(2)(xii) as other sources, given the conditions stated in the stem. Option C therefore matches all three components. The Trap: Option A is the pre-2020 "pass-through means exempt" misconception. Option B incorrectly exempts the interest. Option D incorrectly exempts the dividend (which is only exempt when the SPV has NOT exercised 115BAA - the opposite of the stated condition) and the debt-repayment distribution. Note: The original stem did not specify the SPV's tax regime under Section 115BAA, so the correct treatment of the dividend component was conditional (taxable if 115BAA exercised, exempt under Section 10(23FD) otherwise). The stem now specifies that the SPV has exercised 115BAA and that the debt-repayment distribution meets the s.56(2)(xii) conditions, so option C is uniquely correct. Source: NISM Series-X-B Investment Adviser Level 2 workbook, pp. 277-283.
